xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-shp:DisclosureOfNotesOnShareholdi: Comments on SHP: 1. Additions to the list of Promoter Group during the quarter ended 30 June, 2026 Pursuant to transmission of shares of Late Smt. Umayal R, Ms. R. Muthatha has been included as a Member of the Promoter Group. 2. Deletions to the list of Promoter Group during the quarter ended 30 June, 2026 - Late. Smt. Umayal R consequent to her demise and completion of transmission of shares from her demat A/c. 3. Name of the Company has been changed from Parry International DMCC to Parry International FZCO pursuant to the intimation received in this regard. 4. Convertible Instruments - CCDs: The Company had on 5 October, 2023 allotted 2,00,000 7.5% Compulsory Convertible Debentures (CCD) at a face value of Rs.1,00,000 each to eligible qualified institutional buyers at an issue price of Rs.1,00,000 per CCD. The CCDs are convertible into equity shares of face value Rs.2/- each at a conversion price, which will be determined at the time of conversion as per the terms prescribed in the Placement Document and in line with SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018. The impact of conversion of CCDs on the equity share capital can be determined at the time of conversion of CCD. As at 30 June, 2026, 1,37,000 CCDs have been converted into equity shares.
